title: Red vs Blue
body:
Read this out loud to everyone at the party.

Please pause all activities for a moment.

For the next hour, the party will be split into two teams: a red team and a blue team. All marks collected during this time will not go towards individual player scores; instead, they will contribute to an overall team score. At the end of this hour, every player on the winning team may claim a prize from the prize pool.

The teams are as follows:

Red
- Annalisa
- Celine
- Ethan
- Kendra
- Sam Suite
- Simon
- Will

Blue
- Cameron
- Jake
- Nic
- Sam Strathman
- Story
- Takoda
- Taylor

If your name isn't on this list, you can choose whichever team you like.

Sam will give out colored wristbands to denote teams. Once you get your wristband, you can continue whatever you were just doing. Good luck!
